summary: Round r1 (restricted network). Located the latest ERO National Assessment of Student Achievement main report (2023 cycle) and UIS NADA metadata for NASA grades 3, 5 and 8, plus ERO/DoE/ACER/ADB analyses (search-verified URLs). World Bank HCI/LAYS and WDI completion series, UIS SDG 4 data and CEHRD Flash reports are recorded as leads from general knowledge (unverified). Census 2021 and PWT hc are reused from existing leads. No values retrieved; every empirical item is pending. Key methodological points: NASA scale scores are not necessarily comparable across cycles; survey-based completion, administrative gross-intake ratios and census attainment measure different things and are kept separate; academic years use BS labels distinct from both Nepal FY and calendar year.

findings.claim: Q1: NASA grade-level learning results - mean scale scores and share of students at each proficiency level (below basic/basic/proficient/advanced) by grade (3, 5, 8, 10) and subject (Nepali, English, Mathematics, Science), latest and prior cycles.
findings.period: NASA cycles 2011-2023 (assessment years to be confirmed; school-year basis)
findings.note: Required: NASA main reports by cycle (09A-L01 latest; earlier cycles via ERO, 09A-L02/L03 metadata). Scale scores are only comparable across cycles if equated; check before building a trend.

findings.claim: Q1: NASA learning gaps by province, sex, school type (community vs institutional), location and ethnicity/caste.
findings.note: Required: disaggregation tables in 09A-L01; gap = difference in mean score or in share at/above proficient.

findings.claim: Q1: SDG 4.1.1 minimum proficiency in reading and mathematics (end of primary, end of lower secondary) as reported to UIS.
findings.period: latest reported year (calendar year label in UIS)
findings.note: Required: UIS SDG 4.1.1 series for Nepal (09A-L13); record which national assessment UIS mapped and its year.

findings.claim: Q1: Harmonised test score (HLO) for Nepal used in the Human Capital Index.
findings.period: HCI editions 2018, 2020 and later if published
findings.note: Required: HD.HCI.HLOS or HCI country brief (09A-L10, L11). Record which assessment source the HLO is built from.

findings.claim: Q2: Completion rates (primary, lower secondary, upper secondary) by sex - household-survey basis.
findings.period: latest survey year (e.g. NLSS IV 2022/23, MICS 2019 - to confirm on retrieval)
findings.note: Required: UIS SDG 4.1.2 completion rates by sex/location/wealth (09A-L13).

findings.claim: Q2: Completion proxies (gross intake ratio to last grade) by sex - administrative basis.
findings.period: calendar-year label in WDI; underlying Nepal academic year
findings.note: Required: SE.PRM.CMPT.ZS / SE.SEC.CMPT.LO.ZS (09A-L12) and Flash reports (09A-L14). Keep separate from survey completion; gross ratios can exceed 100 percent.

findings.claim: Q2: Completion / survival to grade 8 and grade 10/12 by province (7 provinces) and sex; SEE pass/grade distribution by province.
findings.note: Required: Flash II reports (09A-L14) survival and promotion tables; Census 2021 attainment by province and sex (09A-L16) as the population-based cross-check.

findings.claim: Q3: Learning-adjusted years of schooling (LAYS) for Nepal, with expected years of school and HLO components.
findings.note: Required: HD.HCI.LAYS (09A-L09) or HCI country brief (09A-L11).

findings.claim: Q3: Human Capital Index (overall) for Nepal, total and by sex.
Q3 cross-check: PWT human-capital index hc for Nepal (years-of-schooling based, no quality adjustment).
findings.note: Required: PWT hc series (09A-L17); used for model input comparisons, not a substitute for LAYS.

findings.claim: Teaching quality: share of trained/qualified teachers and pupil-teacher ratios by level and province.
findings.note: Required: Flash I/II teacher tables (09A-L14), UIS teacher indicators (09A-L13).

findings.claim: Learning and completion enter the human-capital stock as a quality-adjusted schooling measure (LAYS-style: years x HLO/benchmark), not as enrolment.
findings.note: Method choice for the shared model; enrolment alone overstates skill accumulation where learning is low.

findings.claim: Academic years are reported in Bikram Sambat (BS) and do not match either the Nepal fiscal year or the calendar year; each value will carry its BS label and a documented Gregorian mapping.
findings.note: Period-labelling rule; WDI/UIS assign calendar-year labels to school years.

data_gaps: NASA results by grade/subject/province for the latest cycles (2019-2023): main reports not retrieved; exact grades and years of each cycle to be confirmed.
Official cohort completion rates by province and sex: not confirmed as published by MoEST/CEHRD; may require Flash survival tables or Census/NLSS microdata tabulation.
LAYS and HCI for Nepal: edition vintages and whether a post-2020 edition exists are unconfirmed.
Teacher content knowledge / classroom-observation evidence (teaching quality beyond qualifications): no Nepal-specific primary source located yet.

assumptions.text: LAYS (quality-adjusted schooling) is the preferred human-capital stock measure for Agent 01/08; PWT hc is a quantity-only cross-check.
BS academic-year labels are preserved and mapped to Gregorian years with a documented rule; not converted to Nepal FY.

challenges.text: If the growth model uses PWT hc or mean years of schooling as the human-capital input, it will overstate effective human capital where learning is low; carry LAYS alongside and document which one drives TFP/labour-quality assumptions.

Education-selective emigration (students and skilled workers) changes the resident human-capital stock; 23A/23D outflow parameters should be split by education level so 09 can net them from the domestic stock.

uncertainty: High. No values retrieved. NASA cycles differ in grades, subjects and possibly scaling, so trends may not be identifiable; HCI's harmonised test score may rest on a different assessment than NASA; completion measures differ by construction. Several lead URLs are from general knowledge and unverified.

learning_outcomes_table.method: Extract NASA tables per cycle; do not trend scale scores unless the report documents equating/linking; report HLO separately as an internationally harmonised proxy.

series.basis: administrative gross intake to last grade / survival (Flash, WDI)

completion_by_group.method: Keep the three bases separate; reconcile differences (numerators: completers vs entrants to last grade; denominators: age cohort vs official-age population) via find_conflicts.

lays_value.method: Retrieve HD.HCI.LAYS and components; if unavailable for the latest year, compute LAYS = EYS x (HLO / HCI benchmark score, benchmark taken from the retrieved HCI methodology note) only with retrieved EYS and HLO and label as estimate citing both observations.
